messages:
mai: Quick brainstorm  We need a benchmark narrative for the launch post + a webinar demo. Primary hook: show practical savings for product teams while keeping sub-200ms median responses for chat features. Open to visual formats.

oliver: Two visual lanes: 1) stacked-savings bars (per-lever: batching, quant, cache) to show additive % savings; 2) sequence-length waterfall: cost per 1k tokens across [64,256,1024] as separate panels. the waterfall sells the long-tail story.

clara: For copy, split into micro-headlines for 3 placements: hero, social card, and webinar subject line. hero needs short authority line e.g., "Lower unit costs. Same real-time feel." social can be punchier.

raj: For the webinar, plan a live demo where we toggle batching/quant on the same request and show latency + $/1k change in real-time. Add a short poll: "What's your top priority? (cost / latency / resilience)" to segment.

mai: Love the live toggle demo. For marketing charts, we should have one simple credibility chart with real runs (dots) and a bold callout: "Typical savings for production workloads: 20-60%" (conservative range).

oliver: Also include a mini methods panel in the post: how we measured cost (instance list, pricing model, tokenization assumptions). Engineers will scan for reproducibility.

clara: Draft poll fields: priority radio, current monthly tokens (ranges), deploying Dedicated soon? (y/n), and an open field: "Main blocker". We'll use these to tag leads as: cost-focused, latency-focused, or exploring Dedicated.

raj: On routing: webhook from registration -> CRM: create lead with tag = priority + token_range. If priority == latency, route to Solutions; cost -> Growth. Also create an "evaluation request" playbook link for mid-high token ranges.

mai: Charts to request from analytics: per-run median latency (ms), cost_est_per_1k_tokens, batch_size, seq_len. CSV with a run_id and model_variant. Need those by EOD Monday.

oliver: I'll prepare the chart spec: heatmap candidate too but with a simplified color scale (marketing-friendly) and an alternate table for exact numbers (for credibility).

clara: CTA variants: (1) "Run your model on Redwood" (PLG), (2) "Request a benchmark for my workload" (enterprise). Email follow-ups: cost-leads get a calculator; latency-leads get SLO playbook invite.

mai: Can we add an Appendix: "How to reproduce" snippet? propose: 
```
model: llama-small
batch_sizes: [1,8,32]
seq_lengths: [64,256,512,1024]
hardware: a100, rtx8000
quantization: int8
metric: median_latency_ms, cost_per_1k_tokens
```

raj: Sounds good. For SDRs: short script templates (first touch: confirm token volume + ask to run a test; second touch: offer benchmark). We'll keep it <3 emails.

mai: Timeline: first draft post + hero mock by Wednesday noon, analytics CSV by Monday EOD, webinar date 10 business days after publish. Who owns what?

oliver: charts + analytics spec.

clara: poll + CTAs + emails.

raj: routing + SDR scripts + CRM mapping.

mai: I'll own post copy and coordinate design. We'll review Thursday 9am. Thanks all :sparkles:

deploy-bot: Reminder: Marketing content freeze window on 2024-07-01 to 2024-07-05.

oliver: One more: include a short "what this means" sidebar with quick levers and rough conservative savings: batching ~10-25%, quantization ~15-40%, KV cache ~5-20%. keep numbers conservative.

clara: I'll draft that language and make it copy-ready.

mai: Great. Locking in tasks in the sprint board now."
